article.story: Akron (1-9) at UMass (5-5), Nov. 18 at 7 p.m. EST. Opening Line: UMass by 3. Against the spread: UMass 4-6, Akron 4-6. How to watch: CBS Sports Network Key stats UMass Offense Overall: 332 yards per game (119th in FBS) Passing: 192.6 yards per game (103rd) Rushing: 139.4 yards per game (91st) Scoring: 24.3 points per game (93rd) UMass Defense Overall: 337.9 yards per game (42nd in FBS) Passing: 183.4 yards per game (22nd) Rushing: 154.5 yards per game (87th) Scoring: 22.3 points per game (51st) Akron Offense Overall: 341.8 yards per game (106th in FBS) Passing: 212.8 yards per game (86th) Rushing: 129 yards per game (105th) Scoring: 18.6 points per game (130th) Akron Defense Overall: 422.4 yards per game (130th in FBS) Passing: 221.8 yards per game (85th) Rushing: 200.6 yards per game (128th) Scoring: 33.2 points per game (128th) Akron ranks 119th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert on 43.3% of third downs. Akron ranks 132nd in the FBS with a -9 turnover margin, compared to UMass' 35th-ranked +4 margin. Akron is 104th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 88.6% of trips. UMass' red zone offense ranks 34th, scoring on 89.3% of red zone opportunities. Team leaders UMass Passing: William Watson III, 1,349 yards, 9 TDs, 2 INTs, 68.9 completion percentage Rushing: Curtis Kimmons IV, 426 yards on 85 carries, 4 TDs Receiving: T.Y. Harding, 397 yards on 34 catches, 2 TDs Akron Passing: Brayden Roggow, 1,343 yards, 7 TDs, 9 INTs, 58.6 completion percentage Rushing: Jordan Gant, 787 yards on 151 carries, 7 TDs Receiving: Marcel Williams, 502 yards on 42 catches, 5 TDs Last game UMass lost 24-0 to Toledo on Nov. 11. Logan Inagawa led UMass with 99 yards on 10-of-27 passing (37.0%) for no touchdowns and one interception. He also carried the ball 10 times for 40 yards. Kimmons had 33 rushing yards on 11 carries. Drew Alsup recorded 35 yards on two catches. Akron fell 42-14 to Western Michigan on Nov. 10. Cibastian Broughton led Akron with 173 yards on 12-of-18 passing (66.7%) for two touchdowns and no interceptions. Gant had 61 rushing yards on nine carries. Williams had five receptions for 85 yards and two touchdowns. Next game UMass plays at Bowling Green on Nov. 28. Akron hosts Buffalo on Nov. 27.
